summary: Mini-Tone, a Felucca fork with six tracks and a new set of engines modelled on Elektron, Mutable Instruments, Roland and Commodore designs, in place of most of Felucca's own. The 8-voice budget stays shared across the six tracks.
features: Engines incl. 6-op FM, Digitone-style FM and Swarmer, Braids, SID, TB303, TR808
Six tracks, four shown at a time; Felucca's sample engines removed
64 steps with ratchets, fill conditions, p-locks and an automation list
Stochastic and Euclidean generator modes per track
Ping-pong delay and an Elektron-style reverb
USB and TRS MIDI in, clock from USB or TRS, MIDI learn; USB audio

headings: if the fm-1 does not start
